name: Kagi News
desc: Daily press review assembled from community-curated outlets.
desc_zh: 由社区共同维护的媒体清单汇总成的每日新闻摘要
solves: The same headline follows you across ten apps all day. Kagi News gathers one review a day, with several angles per story and no tracking.
solves_zh: 同一个标题整天在十个应用里追着你跑。Kagi News 每天汇总一次，每条新闻给多个角度，而且不做追踪。
best_for: You want the day's news once, from outlets you picked, instead of a feed that never ends.
best_for_zh: 你想每天只看一次新闻，媒体还是自己挑的，而不是面对一个没有尽头的信息流。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://kagi.com/changelog and https://blog.kagi.com/ , then the Kagi produc）。 Launched 2025-09-30, before the discovery window, but the ledger holds only Kagi Assistant for this vendor so it is missing by definition. The changelog entry is headed 'Sept 30th, 2025 - Kagi News' and the blog post carries the same date. Google Play featured it in an editorial spotlight. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://kagi.com/changelog
